outcome: cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (CD NRFHR)
cohort: The study included 142 singleton fetuses with fetal intra-abdominal umbilical vein varix (FIUVV) and 99,715 control subjects from the general population born at a single center.
finding: FIUVV was associated with significantly higher rates of congenital anomalies and small for gestational age (SGA), but not with an increased risk of asphyxia-related adverse outcomes, cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate, or stillbirths.
mod_finding: There were similar rates of cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (CD NRFHR) between FIUVV and control groups, and the study found no evidence to support labor induction before 39 weeks.
gest_age: N/A (a subgroup analysis included deliveries at >=39 weeks)
